description.narrative: Insatsens övergripande mål är att adressera utmaningar och behov relaterade till tillgång till identitetshandlingar (civil dokumentation) och rättigheter gällande bostad, mark och egendom (HLP ¬ Housing, land and property) för återvändare, internflyktingar, inklusive återvändare från nordöstra Syrien, miljömigranter och värdsamhällen.

The overall objective of the intervention is to address challenges and needs related to access to identity documents (civil documentation) and rights concerning housing, land and property (HLP) for returnees, internally displaced persons — including returnees from northeast Syria — environmental migrants, and host communities

The project aims to address challenges related to access to identity documents and rights concerning housing, land, and property (HLP) for returnees, internally displaced persons (IDPs), environmental migrants, and host communities.
Objectives:
Improve access to legal support and reintegration for IDPs, returnees, migrants, and host communities. Strengthen Iraqi authorities capacity to remove structural barriers and improve the issuance of civil documentation. Key Outputs:
Legal and informational support for migrants, IDPs, and returnees, focusing on civil documentation, housing, land, and property rights. Protection measures against gender-based violence and trafficking. Capacity-building for Iraqi institutions involved in civil documentation and property rights. Development of policies and support for Iraqs planning and implementation to enhance access to rights.
